comment: Frame 007, printed p. 1: the heading of the treatise, «I. Algoritmi de numero Indorum.», with the editor's line on the manuscript, Cambridge Ii.6.5, ff. 102r-109v; the beginning of the text: the invocation, the purpose of the book, the nine letters of the Indians and the differences in the forms of their figures. One footnote.

observations: The page number «( 1 )» stands at the head of the page, centred, and the signature «1» of the printed sheet at the foot, centred.

L01-L04: the heading of the treatise, centred: its number in the editor's series, «I.», and its title, «ALGORITMI DE NUMERO INDORUM.», in bold capitals; then, in the smaller type of the notes, the manuscript from which the text is printed: Cambridge University Library, the manuscript marked «Ii. 6. 5», leaves 102 recto to 109 verso. «Ii» is printed in italics, and so are «recto» and «verso».

L05: «DIXIT» opens the text with a large initial D, two lines high, followed by «IXIT» in capitals. The printed note in the right margin beside the line, «car. 102 recto.», gives the leaf of the manuscript at which the text begins; transcribed as a margin note.
The numeral «.ix.» (L10, L16, L20, L25) is printed in small capitals between two points, as the Latin text writes numerals.

L25: the four points after «he» mark the place of the figures of the nine letters, which the edition does not print; the editor's footnote (1) says that the gap is in the manuscript too, at fol. 102 recto, line 18. The footnote counts the lines of the page from the heading «I.»: line 25 is L25 of this transcription.

The lines of the text are printed in the spelling of the manuscript: u for v («uidissem», «uoluerit»), e for ae and oe («que», «preter», «quinte»), «yndos» and «indi», and words divided at the ends of the lines with a hyphen. Transcribed as printed.
The subtitle (L03-L04), the folio in the margin and the footnote are set in a smaller type, darker than the type of the text.

Spaces at punctuation (rule of tools/punct.py: after a mark, a space where the gap is at least 12 px or two thirds of the median word space of the line; before a mark, where it is at least 10 px): without a space after the mark, L22 «exposui,hoc» (9 px, the median word space of the line 16 px) and L24 «inueniri.Leuiterque» (8 px, median 13 px). L22: a speck at mid-height between «ego» and «exposui»; not transcribed.
copy_matter: The stamp «Bayerische Staatsbibliothek München», rectangular, in black, at the head of the page above the page number.

A reader's notes in pencil: L02, a double stroke under «ALGORITMI»; L04, the leaf numbers «102» and «109» struck through, and «104» and «111» written below them; L06, a stroke over «gn» of «dignas»; L11, a stroke like a comma between «suum» and «causa», and a stroke through the «b» of «abre-»; L15, a stroke through the first «s» of «dispersione»; L16, a stroke under «rit» of «algoritmi»; L17, a stroke over «numero». In the right margin, in ink or dark pencil: «algorizmi» beside L05, «| db» beside L11, «| ss» beside L15 and «algorizmi» beside L16. Not part of the edition.

critical_notes.evidence: the editor's footnote, in Italian, has the plural article «nelle» before the singular «linea», where the sense, «in line 25 of the present page», requires «nella»
critical_notes.impact: none: the reference reads the same
